effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[End of Your Turn] By suspending this Tamer, activate 1 of the effects below:
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait in the hand. Reduce this effect's paid cost by 1 for each of your opponent's Digimon.
・2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a [Free] trait Digimon card in the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
